name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €90/MWh on 24 Nov, above the €70 Alert line, with storage well below last year
state: Dutch TTF gas traded near €90.4/MWh on 24 Nov, 11.8% higher on the week and above the €70 Alert line, after an intraday high near €96 on 23 Nov (Yahoo Finance; Trading Economics). EU storage was 69.8% full on 19 Nov against 81.2% a year earlier, as cold forecasts, constrained Gulf LNG and a Norwegian Troll outage tightened supply (Trading Economics).
for_you: High wholesale gas prices tend to feed into energy bills and the Ofgem price cap with a lag. Energy-intensive businesses are most exposed now.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF gas TTF=F
Trading Economics — EU natural gas news

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
